# Errors

Every error the Main Team API answers has this shape, with the same id in the
`X-Request-Id` header:

```json
{ "error": { "code": "not_found", "message": "...", "documentation_url": "https://hub.main-team.org/api/errors#not_found", "request_id": "..." } }
```

Branch on the HTTP status and `code`. `message` is written for people and may change.

## Codes

| Code | Status | Retry | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`invalid_email`](https://hub.main-team.org/api/errors#invalid_email) | 400 | Fix the request or the account first, then send it again. | The request included an email address that does not match the expected format. |
| [`bad_request`](https://hub.main-team.org/api/errors#bad_request) | 400 | Fix the request or the account first, then send it again. | The server could not understand the request due to invalid syntax or failed validation. |
| [`unauthorized`](https://hub.main-team.org/api/errors#unauthorized) | 401 | Fix the request or the account first, then send it again. | The request lacks valid authentication credentials. Every authentication failure answers with this code and this message: a missing or malformed Authorization header, a kid that is not an issued apiKey, an unknown or deactivated account, a bad signature, a token without exp or iat, one whose exp - iat is over 3600 seconds or whose iat is more than 30 seconds ahead of the server, an expired token (30 seconds of tolerance) or a revoked one. Which check failed is not disclosed; quote the request_id to have it looked up. |
| [`forbidden`](https://hub.main-team.org/api/errors#forbidden) | 403 | Fix the request or the account first, then send it again. | The token is valid, but the account may not do this. Every route needs a permission: an allow role whose action grants the route’s, whose target is * or the organization the request acts on (the one in the path; mto on routes without :organizationId), and whose authorized is empty or the account’s own id, with no disallow role matching the same. Roles are set by an operator. A few routes also answer 403 for a rule of their own, and name it in the message, such as a sign-in link for a student without access to that organization. An unconfirmed email address is not one of those rules: the sign-in link is issued either way. |
| [`not_found`](https://hub.main-team.org/api/errors#not_found) | 404 | Do not retry; the same request fails the same way. | No resource exists at the requested location, or it has been removed. On a /v1/:organizationId route, an organization id that is not an ObjectId (24 hex digits), or that names no organization listOrganizations serves (mto included), answers 'Organization not found!'. That is checked after the token, so a request without a valid token gets 401 whatever the id. Some routes give one 404 to every refusal of their own, so a refusal never says which check failed: the certificate and report downloads, and the supervisor link, which answers 'Not found!' alike for a student that is not yours, a student the organization holds no copy of yet, and a username that is nobody’s or not a supervisor’s there. |
| [`conflict`](https://hub.main-team.org/api/errors#conflict) | 409 | Fix the request or the account first, then send it again. | The operation could not be completed because it would create a conflict, such as a duplicate record, a password set for a student who has confirmed their own email address (send them a sign-in link instead), or a second bulk student import while one is still running (the message carries the id of the one that is). Sending the same batch of rows again is not a conflict: it answers 202 with the import you already have. |
| [`payload_too_large`](https://hub.main-team.org/api/errors#payload_too_large) | 413 | Fix the request or the account first, then send it again. | The JSON request body is larger than the limit: 100 kB on every operation but one, and 1.5 MB on createStudentImport, which takes a list of up to 1000 students. The larger limit applies to that exact method and path and to nothing beneath it. The body is refused before authentication, so nothing was read or written. |
| [`unsupported_media_type`](https://hub.main-team.org/api/errors#unsupported_media_type) | 415 | Fix the request or the account first, then send it again. | Send JSON bodies as UTF-8 with Content-Type: application/json, uncompressed or gzip/deflate encoded. |
| [`unprocessable_entity`](https://hub.main-team.org/api/errors#unprocessable_entity) | 422 | Fix the request or the account first, then send it again. | The request body was syntactically correct but failed semantic validation. One operation answers with it: createStudentImport, when one or more rows of a batch cannot be registered. Nothing was queued and nothing was registered, and error.details.rows names every row at fault with its 0-based position, the property, and a code to branch on: invalid_field, unexpected_field, unknown_reference, duplicate_in_request, email_taken_by_your_student (with that student’s _id) and email_unavailable, which never says who holds the address. Fix the rows and send the whole batch again. |
| [`too_many_requests`](https://hub.main-team.org/api/errors#too_many_requests) | 429 | Retry after the number of seconds in `Retry-After`. | Too many requests to one route in one window. Each API account may make 100 requests per 60 seconds to each route; the count belongs to the account, not to the address it calls from, so spreading calls over several servers does not raise it. Wait the number of seconds in the Retry-After header before sending again: a request sent sooner is refused too. Counted responses carry X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining and X-RateLimit-Reset (seconds until the window resets). A request without a valid token is not counted here; such traffic is rate-limited per IP address before it reaches the API. The health check is never counted. One operation has a budget of its own: createStudentImport allows 10 requests per hour per account, because one request to it registers up to 1000 students. Two further limits bound it and are not rate limits: one unfinished import per account (409), and one batch being checked per server at a time (503). |
| [`internal_error`](https://hub.main-team.org/api/errors#internal_error) | 500 | Retry safe requests with exponential backoff and jitter. | Something went wrong on our side. The error has been logged; please retry later. |
| [`service_unavailable`](https://hub.main-team.org/api/errors#service_unavailable) | 503 | Retry safe requests with exponential backoff and jitter. | Work was refused for a reason that will pass, and nothing was queued or written. createStudentImport answers with it when the server is already checking another batch, when bulk registration is paused for a scheduled window, or when checking the batch took too long; each carries Retry-After in seconds, and an import already queued is not lost — it waits and then runs. The readiness check our hosting uses also answers with this code when the API is running but cannot reach a system every authenticated operation depends on; while that lasts, the operations you call answer 500 internal_error. Retry later. |

## Where each code can come from

- `invalid_email`: no operation lists it in the contract.
- `bad_request`: `checkStudentRegistration`, `createApplication`, `createSigninLink`, `createStudentImport`, `deleteApplication`, `getApplication`, `getCountry`, `getExam`, `getExamCategory`, `getGrade`, `getOrgStudent`, `getOrganization`, `getStudent`, `getStudentImport`, `linkStudentSupervisor`, `listAvailableExams`, `listExamApplications`, `listOrgStudents`, `listStudentApplications`, `listStudentCertificates`, `listStudentReports`, `listStudents`, `moveApplication`, `registerStudent`, `revokeToken`, `setStudentPassword`, `updateOrgStudent`, `updateStudent`.
- `unauthorized`: almost every operation.
- `forbidden`: almost every operation.
- `not_found`: `createApplication`, `createSigninLink`, `createStudentImport`, `deleteApplication`, `downloadCertificate`, `downloadReport`, `getApplication`, `getCountry`, `getExam`, `getExamCategory`, `getGrade`, `getOrgStudent`, `getOrganization`, `getStudent`, `getStudentImport`, `linkStudentSupervisor`, `listApplications`, `listAvailableExams`, `listExamApplications`, `listExamCategories`, `listExams`, `listOrgStudents`, `listStudentApplications`, `listStudentCertificates`, `listStudentReports`, `moveApplication`, `setStudentPassword`, `updateOrgStudent`, `updateStudent`.
- `conflict`: `createApplication`, `createStudentImport`, `deleteApplication`, `listStudentApplications`, `listStudentCertificates`, `listStudentReports`, `moveApplication`, `registerStudent`, `setStudentPassword`, `updateOrgStudent`, `updateStudent`.
- `payload_too_large`: `checkStudentRegistration`, `createApplication`, `createSigninLink`, `createStudentImport`, `linkStudentSupervisor`, `moveApplication`, `registerStudent`, `setStudentPassword`, `updateOrgStudent`, `updateStudent`.
- `unsupported_media_type`: `checkStudentRegistration`, `createApplication`, `createSigninLink`, `createStudentImport`, `linkStudentSupervisor`, `moveApplication`, `registerStudent`, `setStudentPassword`, `updateOrgStudent`, `updateStudent`.
- `unprocessable_entity`: `createStudentImport`.
- `too_many_requests`: almost every operation.
- `internal_error`: almost every operation.
- `service_unavailable`: `createStudentImport`.
